questions.question:
The line $y = mx$ is a tangent to the curve $y = \cos x$ at the point where $x = a$, as shown in the diagram.

Which of the following statements is true?
questions.answer:
**B.** From the diagram the point of contact is just before the maximum at $x = 2\pi$, so $a < 2\pi$ and hence $\dfrac{1}{a} > \dfrac{1}{2\pi}$.

At $x = a$ the line meets the curve: $ma = \cos a < 1$, so $m < \dfrac{1}{a}$.

Near $x = a$ the curve is concave down, so the tangent lies above it; at $x = 2\pi$ the line is above $\cos 2\pi = 1$, i.e. $2\pi m > 1$, so $m > \dfrac{1}{2\pi}$.

Therefore $\dfrac{1}{2\pi} < m < \dfrac{1}{a}$.
